description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases to verify the behavior of Subversion (SVN) integration with Git via git-svn. It sets up repositories, performs various clone, init, fetch, and rebase operations with specific include-paths filters, and verifies the correctness of file states and logs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case with a descriptive label and a shell command that performs the test.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files for content equality.
